analyst_view.overall: Sunderland (11th, 7 pts) host Jagiellonia (29th, 3 pts) needing a win to stay near the top eight, after a 2-0 home defeat to Dinamo Zagreb last time in Europe. They drew 0-0 at Aston Villa on Saturday but sit in the Premier League bottom three and host Tottenham on Sunday, so changes are likely; Le Bris confirmed on Wednesday that captain Granit Xhaka (calf) and Brian Brobbey (thigh) miss this game, with Ballard, Mundle and Diarra also out. The numbers count Brobbey (about -23% on Sunderland's goals) and Diarra, but not Xhaka or rotation. Reports differ on whether Trai Hume and Jagiellonia's Taras Romanczuk are banned (one team-news page lists both as suspended after three yellows), so I do not size either. Jagiellonia lost 3-1 at Cracovia, have lost three of four in this phase and play without away fans; Bulgarian referee Georgi Kabakov (about 4.6 cards a game) is in charge.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.2 goals and already take a big slice off Sunderland for Brobbey, with their poor recent scoring (3 in six) also counted. Xhaka's confirmed absence and likely rotation before Spurs are not in the numbers, so I trim a little, to about 2.1.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.7 corners, 7.3 for Sunderland, already a little lower for their recent corner count. Without Xhaka to set the tempo and with changes likely, Sunderland's pressure should be a bit lighter, so I go only to about 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards, already raised for both sides' recent bookings and for referee Georgi Kabakov's above-average record (4.6 a game). Hume and Romanczuk, both on three bookings, may be banned or careful, but the reports disagree, so I stay at 4.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.6 shots, mostly Sunderland (21.4), already up about 8% for their recent shooting. Rotation with Spurs three days later and no Xhaka should trim that a little, so I go to about 27.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.8 shots on target, and Sunderland have been wasteful in front of goal lately. A rotated attack without Brobbey (counted) or Xhaka's passing (not counted) should be slightly less sharp, so I go to about 9.5.
